rules.step: Install the pinned SDD provider validator
rules.rationale: Installs the pinned provider needed by the subsequent source validation.
Restores the locked dependencies used by the validation suites.
Builds the candidate engine consumed by subsequent production-route qualification.

rules.step: Test — core telemetry contracts and source binding
rules.rationale: Runs the independent Core contract suite against the selected source revision.

rules.step: Test — standalone telemetry HTTPS contracts and host boundaries
rules.rationale: Runs the standalone telemetry transport and host boundary contract suite.

rules.step: Test the shared projection and real loopback browser
rules.rationale: Bundles npm/browser installation with dashboard and browser validation; native evidence cannot split the interval.

rules.step: Evaluate with the PR base's policy and validator
rules.rationale: Bundles trusted base/head source fetching and routine policy assessment in one native step.
